headline: Halloween Candy Sales Slump on Elevated Cocoa Prices and Household Squeeze
summary: Halloween candy retail sales in the US are lagging this season as consumers cut discretionary spending in response to living costs and elevated global cocoa prices.
why: Cocoa price spikes and soft consumer response directly test pricing power and volume resilience across global confectioners.

impacts.name: Packaged Food & Confectionery
impacts.why: High ingredient input costs and softer consumer demand weigh on seasonal sales volumes.
